title: Gisèle Lullaby wins Canada's Drag Race Season 3
summary: In the finale (CA-S03-E09), Gisèle Lullaby and Jada Shada Hudson lip-synced to Céline Dion's "A New Day Has Come (Radio Remix)". Gisèle was crowned the winner; Jada finished as runner-up. Kimmy Couture and Miss Fiercalicious were eliminated before the final lip sync. The season cash prize was $100,000 CAD.

title: Halal Bae: Season 3 Porkchop
summary: Halal Bae was the first contestant eliminated on Canada's Drag Race Season 3 (CA-S03-E01), lip-syncing to Justin Bieber and Nicki Minaj's "Beauty and a Beat" against Miss Moço.

title: Vivian Vanderpuss named Miss Congeniality
summary: Vivian Vanderpuss was voted Miss Congeniality after the finale aired; producers announced the win on the show's social media channels rather than in the finale episode (CA-S03-E09). She had been eliminated in CA-S03-E08 after lip-syncing to Rêve's "CTRL + ALT + DEL" against Kimmy Couture.

title: Gisèle Lullaby wins Snatch Game as Marie Curie
summary: In CA-S03-E05, Gisèle Lullaby won Snatch Game portraying Marie Curie — her second consecutive maxi-challenge win after CA-S03-E04's Bitch Stole My Look design challenge.

title: UK finale broadcast delayed after Queen Elizabeth II's death
summary: Following the death of Queen Elizabeth II on September 8, 2022, the broadcast of the CA-S03 finale ("True North Strong (and Fierce)") was delayed in the United Kingdom during the period of national mourning.
